_comment: SEISMIC SCENARIOS across the region. The trigger enters as a pseudo-static coefficient k_h = pga_fraction * PGA added to the force balance, not as a separate model. pga_fraction is a convention and is NOT fitted here, and unstable area is genuinely sensitive to it - 57% at 0.3 against 90% at 1.0 - so quote seismic maps as a range over it. Rainfall needs no such hedge.
name: hkh_eq
